label: Research
title: Four research programs, one technical direction.
description: Neryva's research spans multiple domains because efficiency, reliability, transfer, and optimization are cross-domain problems. Each program reflects a serious technical line of work, not a claim that every area is already fully commercialized.

items.title: Language Systems
items.description: Research on routing, sparsity, training stability, inference efficiency, and practical model deployment.

items.title: Robotics and Task Transfer
items.description: Research on how learned skills move across tasks, environments, and data constraints.

items.title: Clinical AI
items.description: Research on reliability, evaluation, uncertainty, and safe deployment in high-stakes settings.

items.title: Energy and Engineering Optimization
items.description: Research on optimization, constraint handling, and decision support in complex operating environments.
